Plot impulse responses from an mvgam_irf object

Source: R/mvgam_irf-class.R
plot.mvgam_irf.Rd

This function takes an mvgam_irf object and produces plots of Impulse Response Functions

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam_irf'
plot(x, series = 1, responses = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

list object of class mvgam_irf. See irf()

series

Position or name of the process given the shock

responses

Optional positions or names of the processes drawn as response panels. Useful for hierarchical VAR fits where the raw K-panel grid is unreadable. Defaults to all processes.

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

Value

A ggplot object showing the expected response of each latent time series to a shock of the focal series

See also

irf(), fevd(), stability(), plot.mvgam_fevd(), plot.mvgam_stability(), plot.mvgam_forecast()
